title: crises.json string fields have no maximum-length validation and are rendered unclipped
evidence:
core/catalog.odin:
			a.id = jstr(eo, "id")
			a.display_name = jstr(eo, "display_name")
			a.root_cause_pattern = jstr(eo, "root_cause_pattern")
			a.failure_effect = jstr(eo, "failure_effect")
			a.preventive_redesign = jstr(eo, "preventive_redesign")
			...
			if a.id == "" || a.display_name == "" || a.root_cause_pattern == "" ||
				a.failure_effect == "" || a.preventive_redesign == "" {
				return {"crises.json", a.id, "id/display_name/root_cause_pattern/failure_effect/preventive_redesign must be non-empty"}
			}
app/render/crisis.odin:
	card_w := i32(440)
	...
		draw_text_c(v, title, x, ty, 15, p.state_critical)
	...
		draw_text_c(v, redesign, x, ty, 12, p.ink)
detail: crises.json is runtime-loaded, user-editable content (the modding boundary). String fields are type-checked and non-empty-checked but never length-capped: a huge display_name/preventive_redesign clones unboundedly into the permanent allocator and draws unclipped past the fixed 440px card.
recommended_fix: Fail-fast on over-long strings at load (mirror the other ODN-5 rules, e.g. max 256 chars) and/or truncate the banner text to the card width at draw.
